protocol: IAED — International Academies of Emergency Dispatch
description: Rule-based triage assignment for RoadSoS PS #9. Rules are evaluated in priority order. First matching rule wins.

P1.label: Critical
P1.description: Immediate life threat. Dispatch trauma centre, fire brigade, and ambulance simultaneously.

P2.label: Serious
P2.description: Urgent but patient is currently stable. Dispatch ambulance and police.

P3.label: Minor
P3.description: Non-urgent. Dispatch towing or general assistance. No ambulance required.

rules.condition: entrapment == true AND hazard_type IN [fire, fuel_leak]
rules.rationale: Trapped person with active fire or fuel spill — highest IAED priority, mass casualty risk.
Any entrapment is life-threatening without fire confirmation.
Active fire or fuel leak without entrapment still poses mass-casualty risk.

rules.condition: child_involved == true AND intent IN [emergency_crash, medical_emergency]
rules.rationale: Children in crash or medical emergency receive immediate priority per IAED paediatric protocol.
Three or more casualties indicates potential mass casualty incident.
Unknown casualty count in medical emergency — treat as critical until confirmed otherwise.
Small confirmed casualty count — serious but manageable.
Crash or medical emergency with no other slots resolved — default to serious.
No injuries or entrapment — property damage only.
Breakdown or towing request — non-medical, non-injury.
Default fallback — treat as serious if no other rule matches.

casualties.description: Number of people injured or affected. Null means unknown.

entrapment.description: True if any person is physically trapped inside a vehicle or wreckage.
entrapment.extraction: keyword regex (phanse, atke, stuck, trapped, door jammed)

hazard_type.description: Type of environmental hazard at the scene.
hazard_type.extraction: keyword regex — fire keywords checked first, then fuel keywords

child_involved.description: True if a child, infant, or school vehicle is mentioned.
child_involved.extraction: keyword regex (bachha, shishu, child, school bus)

location_mention.description: Raw text reference to a location or landmark. Not geocoded in baseline.
location_mention.extraction: regex (near X, highway N, NH-X, bridge, junction)
